The apartment has two balconies: one by the bedroom with lovely morning sun, and one by the living room that catches the afternoon sun. Enjoy the spacious living area, cosy bedroom and easy access to central Copenhagen — a relaxed home base for exploring the city and unwinding at home.

Cozy 2-room apartment in a classic Copenhagen building in trendy Vesterbro. The bright living room, with original stucco, opens onto a balcony with morning sun and a view of Matthæuskirken. Fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher and washing machine. Bedroom has wide storage and a desk. Just a 2-minute walk to Enghave Plads metro, tucked into the sweet spot between The Meatpacking District and the city center - surrounded by cafés, parks, and sights. Quiet, welcoming, and perfectly central.

This cooperative apartment on the 3rd floor of an older, well-maintained building in Indre By features high ceilings, large windows, and plenty of morning sunlight in the kitchen. The building has an elevator, and the street outside is quiet and one-way.

Forget your worries in this spacious and tranquil space. It's located close to shopping, popular shopping and dining streets, as well as parks and squares with lots of people and a great atmosphere. It's also only 5 minutes to the metro. Perfect for a getaway in Copenhagen, where you can get around the whole city in just 10-20 minutes. Since we live in the apartment on a daily basis, it has everything you could wish for in the city - that's why it's also a very personal apartment with personal belongings.

In the heart of Østerbro, with its vibrant atmosphere and the city's best bakery, Juno, right across the street, lies this charming and newly renovated 5-room period apartment.

110 m², two south-facing balconies, high ceilings, original stucco, 3 en-suite living rooms with wide doorways, and views of the park. Focus on quality, Danish design classics, and art.

Bathroom with underfloor heating, completely finished in Italian marble, dedicated home office, washer and dryer, walk-in closet, custom kitchen with Quooker and wine cooler.

Watch the sun rise above Copenhagen skyline from a place of tranquility, in the historic Carlsberg Byen.

Among restaurants, cafes, and boutiques on beautiful small township-like squares in central Copenhagen, you’ll find the beautifully decorated flat on the 8th floor, with the full view of Copenhagen from the slide-door balcony.

Make this your base for your next visit to the capital of the north.

Please contact for flexibility :)

The apartment on the 3rd floor consists of an open-plan kitchen and living area with a French balcony, a bedroom with a double bed and a changing area, and a smaller bathroom.

From the bedroom, there is access to the balcony, where you can enjoy your morning coffee in the morning sun. In addition, there is access to a green backyard with a playground.

Nearby are popular streets such as Sønder Boulevard, Istedgade and Vesterbrogade, as well as Kødbyen with great places to eat.

The metro and S-train are just 10 minutes away.

Stay in the heart of Copenhagen's historic center with a direct view of Christiansborg. Despite its central location in the old town, the area is wonderfully quiet.

The apartment has two separate bedrooms and is perfect for exploring the city on foot. Strøget, Kongens Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the city's best restaurants, cafes, and attractions are just a few minutes' walk from the door.

The apartment is on the 2nd floor of a historic property without an elevator. You also have access to a small, private courtyard.

This special place is close to green areas and very central, making it easy to plan your visit.
178 sqm with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a huge living room/kitchen with direct access to a spacious 20 sqm roof terrace

Bright, comfortable private room for one guest in a newly renovated Frederiksberg apartment shared with the host couple. The room has a 140 cm bed, private sofa, workspace with reliable Wi-Fi and luggage space. Near Frederiksberg Zoo, Søndermarken, Cisternerne and Damhussøen and University. Ålholm S-train is 300 m away, and bus 7A is 200 m from the door with direct access to central Copenhagen. Free street parking is available with license plate registration. No kitchen or living room access.

Kick back and relax in this quiet and stylish space.

The apartment has a lovely balcony where you can enjoy the evening sun while grilling.

The apartment is located 100 meters from a harbor beach, where you can take a dip in the warm weather.

From the apartment, there is access to the metro within a short walking distance, which means you can be at the main train station in 5-10 minutes.

We have a big spacious apartment right at the best location in Copenhagen and right in the middle of our favorite part of Copenhagen, Oesterbro. We are 200m from the famous lakes and close to the best places in Oesterbro.

Our apartment is a beautiful old apartment with a big open kitchen with a big dining table and a big balcony out to our shared backyard with, a big family room with a couch and tv, a office, a baby/nursing room, a toilet and a bedroom with its own little balcony.

My own home with one of the best locations in Copenhagen. Close to everything. Authentic and cozy with two floors, perfect for both vacation and work. There is a 180x200 bed, and if there are more of you, I can inflate an extra air mattress.

I won't be home when you're here, so of course you'll have the apartment all to yourselves.

I've received feedback that I should indicate what floor the apartment is on. It is located on the 4th floor. I was also told that check-in was a bit difficult, so I made a short check-in video. :)

Enjoy Østerbro in this peaceful and centrally located home. With a short distance to Østerport and both Kastellet and Nordhavn within walking distance, you won't miss anything in Copenhagen. The apartment has a large, bright kitchen-living room, a bathroom with a separate shower, and a bedroom with a mirror and a queen-size bed that sleeps two people. There is a south-facing balcony from the living room that opens onto the backyard, so there is no noise from the street.

This beautiful pearl of an apartment is perfect for couples or smaller groups. The apartment is a bright, character-filled apartment set in a classic Copenhagen building. It is a spacious apartment with one bedroom + a large sofa bed in the living room

The apartment is located in a charming area with cafes, shops and restaurants. Close to several train stations.

You’ll be staying right in the heart of Copenhagen, where the city’s energy and charm come together. This bright penthouse apartment is your base for exploring the capital’s sights, while offering a peaceful retreat to come home to. Here, you can start your day with coffee before heading out to explore, and end it with a glass of wine on the balcony.

Charming apartment on a quiet street in the heart of Christianshavn, one of Copenhagen’s oldest and most beautiful neighbourhoods. Enjoy a cosy open-plan kitchen and living area, a newly renovated bathroom and a comfortable double bed. Located on the ground floor, just 1 min. from the metro and only 15 min from the Airport. Surrounded by canals, historic streets, cafés and restaurants, it’s the perfect base for couples, solo travellers, business trips and anyone wanting to experience Copenhagen.

Enjoy the simplicity of life in this peaceful and centrally-located home.
Sleeps up to four people, comfortably for two. Children are allowed. Quiet courtyard.
Coffee machine, fully equipped kitchen, access to a cozy garden.

In the heart of Nørrebro, close to the metro, S-trains, and buses to everything Copenhagen has to offer🌱

No smoking indoors. Please minimize the use of perfume indoors, as the smell lingers in the furniture. 🌸

New renovated apartment in the central part of Frederiksberg (C) with a five minute walk to the lakes of Copenhagen. Cut off from the noice of the inner city, but no more than five minutes to central Copenhagen on the metro or bus.

Quality scandinavian furniture and a fully equipped kitchen, full wardrobe space, ideal for longer stays in Copenhagen.

Balcony with morning sun, bedroom facing away from the street and personal workspace.

Nice and bright room in the heart of Østebro. 50 meters to the metro and supermarkets. As well as close to bars, café areas and the beach. The room is quiet and close to the entrance and the shared bathroom. The room has a small fridge and a water boiler. So easy food, tea and coffee can be made in the room.

Bright and cosy 61 m² apartment on the 3rd floor in classic Islands Brygge. The harbour is just down the street, with a small water view from the living room. Hart, Andersen Bakery, Sneezing Fruits and ROAST are nearby, and Wulff & Konstali is just across the street. Large 180×200 cm bed, kitchen with gas stove, and a small classic Copenhagen bathroom with shower in the room. A lovely local base close to the metro, city centre, cafés, restaurants, and green spaces. Perfect for 1–2 guests in CPH.

Cozy little boat with sleeping space, perfect for a different and cozy overnight stay on the water. The boat is compact and has no toilet or shower on board, but right nearby there are good, heated common facilities with a toilet, hot showers, and laundry facilities. Enjoy the cozy harbor atmosphere and wake up right by the water. A simple, charming and unique little getaway.

You’ll find yourselves in a modern home built in 2014, designed for family life with a balance between shared and private spaces. Light streams in gently, and you’ll feel the tranquility right away. The courtyard creates a secluded spot for meals, while the rooftop terrace is perfect for long summer evenings where time just seems to fly by.

An apartment at Østerbro in Copenhagen, the area is quiet and very safe. Easy access to Fælledparken and the rest of Østerbro and Nordhavn. The apartment is between two stops of the metro (Poul Hennigsens Plads and Vibenshus Runddel), approximately 800 m to each. There is also a train station approximately 1 km from the apartment.

Charming 3-room apartment, perfectly located in the heart of Copenhagen near the lakes. With room for up to 6 adults, it’s an ideal base for families, friends or couples travelling together. Just step outside to discover cafés, restaurants and shops, while many of Copenhagen’s top attractions are within walking distance.

Cool and calm scandi apartment located in the heart of popular Islands Brygge, right by the
waterfront.
The five room two story apartment displays classical danish design, wooden floors and two
balconies.
The upper level features a serene double bedroom, a peaceful terrace overlooking the quiet
courtyard, and an inviting lounge with a generous daybed, perfect for unwinding with your
favorite music.
Downstairs you find an airy, open-plan kitchen and living space.

Lovely apartment on the 4th floor. Apartment in a quiet neighborhood, a few minutes from the city center.

The apartment is located in Østerbro a few hundred meters from Fælledparken, the S-train and metro, and just 1.5 km from Svanemøllen Strand.

The area is filled with cafes, coffee bars, restaurants, and shopping options.

The apartment has a large balcony with morning sun, Wi-Fi, smart TV, Nespresso coffee machine, electric kettle, dishwasher, microwave and all the basics.

Via the back staircase, you have access to a large yard with grass, garden furniture, and a sandbox.
Enjoy Copenhagen from our lovely apartment in Østerbro. Our apartment has a large and lovely open-plan kitchen and a lovely bedroom with a balcony.

Welcome to our spacious and cozy 125 m² apartment in Nørrebro. Here you have 2 bedrooms, 1 children's room, 2 bathrooms with bathtubs and a laundry area. Studio near Royal Arena and the M1 metro, taking you to Nørreport in 12 minutes.
